scientific_scope_status: For nonzero real polynomials p_i and a latent law with density strictly positive almost everywhere on R^m, define F_i=1{p_i<0}. Collect distinct sign-changing irreducible factors q_j and masks v_j=(ord_qj p_i mod2)_i. For a regular output c0, the source claims aff_F2(supp F)=c0+span(v_j); exact constant parities are the orthogonal kernel. The crossing lemma finds a simple real root of each sign-changing irreducible away from all other factors using generic-line resultants. Sign-definite factors and even powers contribute only an offset. This extracts the affine hull, not full support or probabilities: x(x+y),y(x+y),xy attain000,101,011 but not110 although their masks span the even-parity code.
